note: Every checker (plan/playtest/montecarlo/plausibility.mjs --edge-cases, server PlausibilityRules.cs, Unity RunLogPlausibility.cs) must give these verdicts and reasons (rule, minute, value and bound rounded to 0.1). Hand-made: change a case here, in its log file and nowhere else.

cases.name: minute_at_bound
cases.what: minute 1 exactly at its bound (20) and the run total exactly at its bound (5 + 20 = 25): equal is not over

cases.name: minute_over_bound
cases.what: minute 1 one kill over its bound (21 > 20); the run total stays at its bound (4 + 21 = 25)

cases.name: minute_beyond_bounds_uses_last
cases.what: minute 4, past the bounds array: the last bound (30) applies; 31 is over

cases.name: minute_edge_trailing_empty_minute
cases.what: a run ending exactly on a minute's edge (120.0 s) keeps its last empty minute open; it uses its own bound index

cases.name: total_over_at_minute_edge
cases.what: the run total crosses its bound at minute 1 (10 + 16 = 26 > 25) with every minute inside its own bound

cases.name: hull_at_tolerance
cases.what: 50 hull, 20 taken: expected 30, allowed 30 + 5 + 10% of 100 = 45; 45 is not over

cases.name: hull_over_tolerance
cases.what: the same minute with 45.1 hull: over the allowed 45

cases.name: hull_max_grows_at_tolerance
cases.what: max hull 100 -> 120 (the growth counts as hull): expected 50 - 20 + 20 = 50, allowed 50 + 5 + 12 = 67

cases.name: hull_heal_at_tolerance
cases.what: healed 30 then taken 10 from 50: expected 70, allowed 70 + 5 + 10 = 85

cases.name: hull_first_minute_free
cases.what: the first minute has no previous minute: never checked

cases.name: overtime_at_limit
cases.what: 1020 s: 120 s past the 900 s deadline, exactly the bound

cases.name: overtime_over_limit
cases.what: 1020.5 s: 120.5 s past the deadline, over the bound (reported on the last minute)

cases.name: level_one_without_xp
cases.what: level 1 with no XP: the XP level is 0, counted as 1

cases.name: level_equals_xp_level
cases.what: 30 XP is exactly level 2 (10 + 20): level 2 is not over

cases.name: level_one_xp_short
cases.what: 29 XP is level 1: level 2 is over

cases.name: level_equals_xp_level_past_table
cases.what: the table continued past its end (its last steps, 10 a level: 40 from level 3): 100 XP is exactly level 4

cases.name: level_xp_past_table_short
cases.what: 99 XP: level 3 (level 4 needs 100), so level 4 is over
